subject: Civil Engineering
title: Project Delivery Methods
description: A micro-lesson that makes Project Delivery Methods usable.

hook.text: Who designs? Who builds? Who takes risk? The delivery method answers all three questions.

buildup.text: Design-bid-build separates design and construction — the owner hires each independently.

discovery.text: Design-build combines both under one contract — faster delivery, single point of responsibility.

twist.text: CM at risk puts the construction manager in charge early — they guarantee a maximum price.

climax.text: Integrated project delivery (IPD) shares risk and reward — all parties succeed or fail together.

punchline.text: How you organize the team determines whether the project succeeds or fails.

quiz.question: What is the key advantage of design-build over design-bid-build?
options: It always produces higher quality buildings
One contract covers both design and construction, enabling faster delivery
It eliminates the need for a construction manager
